card.title: The Debt Changes Hands
card.instruction: Treat every favor as shifting who owes whom. Recalculate the balance whenever help is accepted, refused, or remembered.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You fixed my bike, so I owe you dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was repaying the dinner you cooked last week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then your repair was too good. I owe you for the surplus kindness.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now you're saving me work. The debt has increased.

mechanism: A recalculates kindness debt even when B says an earlier favor already balanced it or refuses more help.
confusable: Unlike gratitude alone, accepting, remembering and refusing help must all alter the claimed balance.
comparison: S224-a refusal increases debt by saving labor; S224-b extra difficulty reverses the direction of repayment.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
